label: preparing
what: A confidential surprise jubilee celebrating the mayor's forty years of service, in the great hall on day 1 at 18:00: 200 loaves and eight lanterns, with the mayor brought under the cover of a routine lighting inspection. Baker supplied oven use and the final 44 loaves by trade; neighbour arranged escort and sought donations; secretary knowingly agreed to escort and confidentiality. Mayor heard about a supper and service acknowledgement but is not shown being told the jubilee's true purpose.
